base: domain/food-systems with main merged in; the merge staged and uncommitted when these checks ran
evidence: Literature assessment rebuilt on the hydrosphere's cold-waters study, with source and document checks. No biological trials, ecological simulations, lake model, empirical yields or new production coefficients.

document_checks.source_register: 21 unique source IDs (ST01-ST21), every one cited in the chapter; access, support and limits recorded for each
document_checks.relative_links: Every relative link in the chapter resolves (eel_habitat_hatchery.md, culinary_evaluation.md, eel_sources.json, sturgeon_sources.json, sturgeon_checks.json, biosphere/ecology/machines.md, resources/sea_phosphorus.md)
document_checks.hard_wraps: None: one line per paragraph or list item
document_checks.narration: No narration of the author and no attribution of decisions; ideas from the ideation session of 4-5 November and the review of 6 November labelled as ideas
document_checks.temperatures_on_rates: Every rate carries its temperature, or the chapter states that the abstract read gave none (ST13, ST14)

source_checks.ST02_reread: Caspian Biodiversity Information System page re-read 2026-11-07: spawning at 6-16 C (Ural runs at 7-11 and 10-15 C), eggs and larvae at 9-15 C, juveniles at 15-26 C, adults at 20-31 C in summer, most females mature at 15-20 years; the chapter of 6 November gave female maturity as 16-22 years, replaced by these values
source_checks.ST20_added: IUCN press release of 21 July 2022, read in full for its sturgeon passages
source_checks.ST21_added: WWF Central and Eastern Europe account of the same update, read in full
source_checks.consulted_not_cited: Congiu, Gessner and Ludwig (2023), Oryx 57(1): 9-10; no species categories in its readable text

product_checks.cold_waters: Values taken from research/studies/cold_waters/README.md on domain/hydrosphere (1ac9357d) and read against it: 543 lakes below 20 C covering 220,000 km2; 15 below 18 C covering 583 km2; a 30 m lake's floor at 21.1-21.7 C; 0.5 m pond below 20 C for 244 h and below 18 C for 39 h, 1 m pond 181 h and 4.5 h, 2 m pond 24 h and 0 h, of each 709-hour lunar day
product_checks.oxygen: 8.941 mg/L at saturation at 21 C under the design air (biosphere.ecology.lake.oxygen_saturation, 1.2 atm, O2 fraction 0.17436), so the register's 3.5-6.3 mg/L in the deep lakes' deepest tenth is 39-70% of saturation
product_checks.eel_scale: The closed systems' 5.42 GW for fed eel at 8 billion people and 1 kg of cooked eel each, from results/eel_budget.json

decisions_cited: research/decisions.md on main: the rules for what lives wild (12 October) and their application to every wild line bred from Earth stock (6 November); the waters' trophic design and the deep lakes' oxygen (19 October); organisms crossing between worlds (6 November); the food-systems branch's register read as ideation (7 November); the turned design years at the target (6 and 7 November)

tests.note: The chapter has no code of its own; the run covers the study's tests, the eel accounts it cites among them

not_performed: Complete full-text appraisal of abstract-only sources
